profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Meta Superintelligence Labs | Building products, platforms, and AI systems
profile.summary:
I’m a staff software engineer at Meta with 20+ years of experience across software engineering and technology. In Meta Superintelligence Labs, I develop the Muse applications and lead Musecode’s data flywheel.

My work combines hands-on engineering, architecture and technical direction across teams, with experience spanning AI applications, developer harnesses and data feedback systems.

Earlier at Meta, I led the redesign and rebuild of the global candidate portal and shared recruiting platform. Before Meta, I owned Wayfair’s sales and service platform, and led development of AI capabilities for these teams.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Meta Superintelligence Lab
positions.description: I lead Musecode’s data flywheel and work on application development for Muse, where I’ve also worked on evaluations. I work with product, research and infrastructure teams on technical design.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Recruiting Products
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Led the redesign and rebuild of Meta’s global candidate portal and shared recruiting platform, saving recruiters more than 10,000 hours.
- Set technical direction for recruiting applications, including AI-assisted workflows, and improved testing, observability and code review practices across teams.

positions.title: Special Government Employee (SGE)
positions.description: Advise the Office of the CIO on technology strategy in a concurrent, part-time role.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the work to add generative AI to Wayfair's sales and service platform, including chatbots, AI recommendations, and conversation summaries. Improved sales team efficiency by 20%. 
- Built and evolved product and platform capabilities used by sales and service teams, with a focus on reliability, observability, and proactive monitoring. 
- Set technical direction through architecture reviews, design documents, and prototypes that helped teams adopt new technologies. 
- Mentored engineers, ran technical interviews, and helped hire senior talent.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Front-End Development · Java · GraphQL · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · REST APIs · Docker Products · Back-End Web Development · Agile Application Development · Web Design · TypeScript · Web Application Development

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Web Developer - Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Built web products end to end for nonprofits, startups, and Fortune 500 clients. 
- Led a mix of in-house and remote developers and worked directly with clients to shape requirements, manage feedback, and keep delivery on track. 
- Served as the primary technical contact for stakeholders and incorporated feedback into product and delivery decisions.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Front-End Development · GraphQL · REST APIs · Back-End Web Development · Agile Application Development · Web Design · Web Application Development

positions.title: IT Specialist and Programmer
positions.description:
- Streamlined Systems Development: Designed and built a ticketing system and HR management system from the ground up, driving internal operational efficiency and simplifying workflows across the organization.

- Infrastructure Oversight: Managed server and database operations, focusing on infrastructure resilience and reliability to support seamless performance and minimize downtime.

- Custom Scripting for Enhanced Productivity: Developed targeted scripts tailored to boost the functionality of sales agents' computers, directly improving their productivity and day-to-day experience.

- Proactive Technical Support: Delivered fast, effective technical support, resolving issues proactively to ensure optimal system uptime and high user satisfaction.

positions.title: IT Support Analyst
positions.description:
• Platform Development: Developed a PHP and MySQL-based platform for distributing stock recommendations to clients, enhancing client engagement and decision-making.
• Technical Support: Provided comprehensive technical support to various business units, ensuring smooth operations and prompt issue resolution.
• Data Analysis Scripts: Authored scripts to meticulously analyze stock reports, aiding in data-driven decision-making.
• System Management: Managed the installation, configuration, and maintenance of operating systems and applications, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

positions.title: Helpdesk
positions.description:
• Maintained lab computers.
• Managed desktops, laptops to networked peripherals.
• Assisted students and facility with prompt and reliable technical assistance.
